normative_precedence: This contract overrides M166 only where M186 identified an unresolved choice: quota ordering, origin N, product-manifest encoding/failure mapping, and the synthetic instrument.

raw_artifact.name: sha256-raw-bytes-lowerhex-v1
raw_artifact.preimage: the exact file bytes, with no text decoding, newline normalization, container decoding, or length prefix

quota.digest_order: the 32 digest bytes compared lexicographically, equivalent to one unsigned 256-bit big-endian integer

synthetic_prf.encoding: 32 raw digest bytes; every integer in payload is unsigned big-endian

quota_selection.cell_id: UTF8 arm|capture_id|site_id|xxxxxxxx|yyyyyyyy, x/y zero-padded lowercase unsigned 32-bit hexadecimal
quota_selection.selection: retain the first quota entries under the total sort key
quota_selection.duplicate_rule: duplicate cell_id is truth-package invalidity before sorting

origin_fit.population: all fixed truth-target rows in one capture and one admitted truth realization; never a site, class, or bootstrap subset
origin_fit.N: count(candidate_valid && truth_target) in the full unresampled capture population
origin_fit.sum: exact real sum of the included binary64 raw_step values, rounded once to binary64
origin_fit.origin_step: sum / N in binary64 round-to-nearest ties-to-even
origin_fit.meaning: the unweighted arithmetic-mean residual of the finite candidate estimates, hence the least-squares additive translation on the values that exist
origin_fit.invalid_targets: remain in every validity denominator and are not imputed as zero residuals
origin_fit.bootstrap: refit once on the full capture after the frozen reference perturbation, then hold fixed while site clusters are resampled

depth_product.manifest_json: UTF-8 without BOM; RFC 8259 JSON; duplicate keys, NaN, Infinity, and unrecognized properties are invalid
depth_product.required_binding_comparison: every binding sha256 and byte_length must equal the independently frozen campaign value
depth_product.valid_pixel: mask=1; depth finite; sigma finite; sigma sign bit zero
depth_product.grid: all four TIFFs have the campaign width/height; the three product planes and rgb.tif share integer pixel centres, top-left origin, x right, y down; no checker resampling
depth_product.depth_axis: camera optical-axis distance in micrometres, increasing away from the sensor, after the frozen field-curvature correction
depth_product.allowed_fit: one arbitrary additive origin per capture, removed only by the checker; no sign, scale, slope, plane, field-curvature, or nonlinear candidate fit

synthetic_instrument.layout: twenty independent 256x256 tiles in row-major 5x4 order; no kernel crosses a tile boundary
seed_disclosure_gate: then decrypt and verify the one precommitted seed
render frames while withholding seed and truth from the candidate process
freeze candidate product hashes before releasing latent labels or truth
synthetic_instrument.seed_failure: a missing seed, commitment mismatch, second draw, or pre-freeze disclosure is UNMEASURED_SYNTHETIC_TRUTH; no replacement seed is permitted
synthetic_instrument.prf: SHA256(ASCII("M10-SYNTH-PRF-V1") || 0x00 || seed[32] || uint8(label_length) || ASCII(label) || payload), with unsigned big-endian payload integers
synthetic_instrument.tent8: tent8(t) = 4 - abs((t mod 8) - 4), where mod returns 0..7
synthetic_instrument.truth_depth_um: 8 * selected_surface_steps; exact integer arithmetic before binary64 serialization
synthetic_instrument.boundary: vertical continuous line x=boundary_column+0.5 in each tile; signed distance is x-(boundary_column+0.5), negative near and positive far
synthetic_instrument.visibility: near layer visible at integer columns x<=boundary_column; far layer exists everywhere
synthetic_instrument.texture_payload: label TEX; payload uint32(instance)||uint8(layer near=0/far=1)||uint8(channel R=0/G=1/B=2)||uint16(x)||uint16(y)
renderer: For each output pixel, layer, and channel, intersect the square radius-r window with its 256x256 tile.
near_sum is the sum of near texture over visible-near samples in the near window; near_count is their count; near_area is the full near-window area.
far_sum is the sum of far texture over the full far window; far_area is its area.
Store samples as interleaved R,G,B unsigned 16-bit little-endian, row-major y then x. The materialized decoded byte arrays, not a container library, are normative.
synthetic_instrument.input_adapter: any TIFF/DNG wrapper is admissible only if an independent decode reproduces the normative RGB16LE frame bytes exactly; otherwise UNMEASURED_SYNTHETIC_TRUTH
target_selection: Near-interior target mask contains 101 disjoint horizontal witness triples centred at the first x in 40..47 with (x+phase_x) mod 8=4, on y=24+2*i for i=0..100, plus the 197 lowest TARGET-PRF keys among the remaining geometrically eligible cells.
Each other class contains the 500 lowest TARGET-PRF keys among its geometrically eligible cells.
TARGET PRF payload is uint32(instance)||uint8(class_code 0..3 in listed class order)||uint16(x)||uint16(y); ties use y then x.
These four 500-cell sets are the truth-only eligible masks. The general M10 quota rule sees exactly quota cells and retains all of them.

affine_certificate.population: the 2000 scored targets in one instance
affine_certificate.acceptance: all triple points are distinct scored targets and abs(z0-2*z1+z2)>4 focus steps
affine_certificate.proof: for residual to any affine plane, the affine second difference is zero; if all three absolute residuals were <=1 step then the residual second difference would be <=4 steps. Each disjoint triple therefore forces one distinct residual >1. With 101 such residuals among N=2000, nearest-rank q0.95 is strictly >1 step.

commissioning_mutations: exact serialized truth map with all-valid mask and zero candidate sigma passes
z_pred=C-z_true gives Spearman rho=-1 and fails
any affine plane is rejected by the accepted certificate and p95 bar
replace every boundary prediction by the midpoint of its two local surfaces; minimum error is five steps and both boundary vetoes fail
universal invalidity fails fixed-denominator validity and synthetic-interior confusion

checker_modes.availability: reports UNMEASURED_PRODUCT_ABSENT when no candidate package exists; cannot emit an M10 PASS or FAIL
checker_modes.score: requires a committed campaign manifest and a candidate package; missing or malformed candidate artifacts are candidate failures

failure_mapping.candidate_output_open_rule: candidate output bytes are not opened unless checker-contract and truth-preflight stages are completely PASS

unknown_failure.rule: an unmapped condition is emitted and counted as CHECKER_ERROR; it may never be ignored, skipped, or treated as PASS

failure_mapping.multiple_failure_rule: collect every failure code, sort first by stage_order and then by its order in known_failures, report the whole list, and use the first code as primary_disposition; all non-PASS truth/product/checker outcomes project to the single verdict UNMEASURED, while any candidate-product failure after passed truth preflight projects to the single verdict FAIL
failure_mapping.blocked_child_rule: every required child record blocked by a failed parent receives the parent's attribution with a DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED reason; SKIP is not an outcome
failure_mapping.summary_equation: total_examined = PASS + CANDIDATE_FAIL + PRODUCT_UNMEASURED + TRUTH_UNMEASURED + CHECKER_ERROR
failure_mapping.summary_assertion: the five counts are non-negative integers and their sum must equal total_examined or the checker returns UNMEASURED_CHECKER_ERROR

metric_decision.nonfinite_candidate_derived_value: map to the candidate-worst value specified by M166; never omit the row
